en.title: Task Scheduling (Parallel Same-Type with Memory Limit)
en.description:
Each task takes 1 unit of time. Two tasks can be processed in parallel if and only if they have the same type and their total memory is ≤maxMemory; every other task is processed alone. Find the minimum total processing time.

The explicit standard input/output format and supplementary constraints on this site belong to the online version and are not presented as the original source constraints.
en.input: The input contains N, maxMemory, N values of taskMemory, and N values of taskType. 1≤N≤200000, 1≤taskMemory[i]≤maxMemory≤10^9, 1≤taskType[i]≤10^9. This site specifies that every task can run alone, even if its memory does not allow it to run in parallel with another task.
en.output: Output the minimum number of time units.
en.explanation: Group tasks by taskType. In each group, sort by memory and pair the smallest with the largest; if their sum does not exceed the limit, run the pair in parallel, otherwise the largest task can only run alone.
